lm-eval EleutherAI · lm-evaluation-harness

The community-standard open-source harness with 200+ benchmarks. Supports multiple-choice, log-likelihood, and generate_until tasks. Widely adopted for reproducing published results and CI/CD eval pipelines.

78 In Framework 176 Ready 409 Possible

Best for: Reproducing published benchmark results; automated eval pipelines.

Inspect UK AI Safety Institute · inspect_ai

Purpose-built for safety and alignment evaluations. Its unique model_graded_qa() scorer enables rubric-based and scenario evaluations that lm-eval cannot handle. Task types: choice(), match(), model_graded_qa(), model_graded_fact().

38 In Framework 23 Ready 29 Possible (model-graded unique)

Best for: Safety/alignment evals requiring LLM-as-judge.

LightEval HuggingFace · lighteval

Lightweight, HuggingFace-native harness with the easiest HF dataset integration. Task types mirror lm-eval: multichoice, generate_until, loglikelihood. No "In Framework" tier is tracked (all scored as Ready/Possible).

99 Ready 771 Possible

Best for: Teams in the HF ecosystem; fast iteration on new models.

HELM Stanford CRFM · helm

Holistic Evaluation of Language Models uses a scenario abstraction layer providing the broadest metric coverage of any framework. Papers tagged helm: "incorporated" in the vault.

19 In Framework

Best for: Comprehensive multi-metric evaluation with scenario reuse.

OpenAI Evals OpenAI · evals

JSONL registry format with templates: Match, ModelBasedClassify, FreeForm. All 2,043 vault papers have been scored against this framework — the highest Ready + Possible counts of any framework.

783 Ready 872 Possible

Best for: Structured community contributions; judge-based free-form evals.
